title: Favorite trumpet players and early brass band marches
summary: Sam Morgan's sweet style, Manuel Perez as a blaster, and early brass bands playing marches only.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Who were some of your favorite trumpet players when you were growing up other than Chris? Well I liked it all.
I liked the punch, I liked the Rene, all of them had different styles, Sam. I liked them all. I just liked the music, period. Yeah.
What kind of music did Sam feature?

Well he was more on the sweet side. He played, he had this old fish head and all of them. He had a kind of, the most solid beat with his music, you know what I mean? And sweet. He wasn't rough. He wasn't a rough trumpet player.
Did he play in the thunks?

Well I never knew him to play in the thunks. I know mostly he used to travel on the coast. He was a big name for that at that time. He was great. Nobody, when he was in town and in places like that, that was it. People flocked to him. He used to play on the Astoria. He'd be packaging all the time. But mostly his playing was out of town.
Have you ever heard any of the Sam Morgan records?
Yeah I heard his records sing on and everybody talking about Sam, yeah.
Did he sound like that in person? Yeah. The records did him justice in it.
Yeah that's the way it sounded.
Sweet like that. Yeah. Who were the loud trumpet players in there, the real blasters in those times?
Well I know Manny Perez was a loud, loud man. He blastered a lot.
Did he play any jazz? All in his way.

But at that time when I, before I started playing the music, those bands, manual bands and so forth like that, they didn't play this kind of stuff like we do on the street. No, you know. They played marches at all times. Everything that they played was by the paper. See, they go to get the body marches, fuel marches, and they leave, marches again.
Well did they have any real trunk brass bands?
Well at that time I didn't know of any other than no. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
